prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
This is the ONE targeted revision of image 5, a new pixel dialogue portrait of moda. Apply all QA corrections together.
INPUT ROLES: Images 1–4 are exact integer-enlarged low-resolution pixel STYLE REFERENCES (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore); image 5 is the v1 REDRAW TO REVISE, which also supplies this person's identity. Do not merge the people. Style must come from 1–4, not the polished cartoon of 5.

CRITICAL CORRECTION 1: Replace the very bright cartoon white eye patches and winged thick eyeliner in image 5. Eyes must be small, dark, deeply shadowed, with no bright white at all: the sclera is a tiny single muted brown-gray pixel or two next to a dark pupil, similar to references 1–4. Narrow natural eyelids, NO eyelash wings or huge black-outlined oval eyes. Preserve the direction and identity of her skeptical sideways gaze.

CRITICAL CORRECTION 2: Tighten face composition. Make the actual FACE larger relative to hair, neck and clothing. The face (not hair/headwear) is the dominant main block, roughly 42–45 logical pixels wide and 58–62 pixels tall. Keep the crown hair/headwear compact without cutting it off. Very short neck: from the bottom of the chin to the upper clothing edge only about 6–8 logical pixels, no long bare triangular neck. Clothing only the bottommost 5–7 logical pixels; no upper chest or shoulders. Maintain large nose and cheekbone color masses, each readable as several simple flat connected blocks.

CRITICAL CORRECTION 3: Regenerate the complete silhouette with TRUE transparent free space around ALL hair, ears and kerchief knot inside the source image. Outer silhouette should be wholly within x=5..68 and y=5..95 of the logical 74×100 frame. Do not merely pad an existing cut-off shape. Especially preserve generous visible transparent clearance at the right edge. No ear, curl, scarf fold or knot clipped by the canvas.

IDENTITY LOCK: MODA: a WOMAN IN HER FORTIES. Retain dark brown loose wavy hair, worn ochre/yellow kerchief and its modest rear tied knot, prominent ruddy red nose tip. Shrewd appraising sideways glance, firm dry mouth, under-eye middle-age planes, cheekbones and nose broad chunky masses. Rust-red cape is reduced to a VERY NARROW RUST COLLAR EDGE, with a single line of slate-blue dress underneath. The costume must not form big shoulders, bib, cape wings or bow. No tall collar. No youth, drunken silliness, helplessness or crone.

PIXEL MEDIUM: a gritty, coarse LOW-RESOLUTION portrait built for 74×100 logical pixels, each pixel visibly chunky; if output larger, only the effect of integer magnification of that small grid. At most 32 flat earthy working colors. Deliberate hard stair-step contours, large flat contiguous light/mid/shadow planes, tiny asymmetry and clear age. No micro-detail, smoothing, gradients, antialiasing, noise, speckling, high-resolution cartoon illustration, glossy skin, beauty portrait, blush dots or dithering. No bright eye white. Real transparent RGBA background, not black or checkerboard. One person, no hands/props/text/frames. Preserve actual age and colors, change only the QA items and required pixel simplification.
